customer: Hello, I'm hoping to sell my hatchback to Northwind, but I can't find a paper title anywhere. I'm in Texas and put a lot of commuting miles on the car, so I'd like to get this sorted before I book an appointment. Could you tell me what I need to do?
agent: Thanks for reaching out! Texas uses electronic titles, so for a sale to Northwind you usually don't need a printed copy, because we transfer the electronic title at the appointment. If you'd still like a printed duplicate, you can request it online from the Texas motor vehicle agency, and it arrives in 5 to 7 business days. You can find more details in our article "Getting a duplicate title in Texas."
